data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'lau' (light) and 'yah' (God), Lioraiah is a beautiful and meaningful name that evokes the idea of God's light illuminating the world and guiding individuals on their spiritual journey. The name Lioraiah carries the meaning “God's Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lioraiah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Modern usage of this name varies across Christian cultures, but its core meaning remains a profound expression of devotion and faith.
